text: Assumption: The query or transmission of the final diagnostic result is performed via separate interfaces — is this correct?

norm: the query or transmission of the final diagnostic result is performed via separate interfaces
assumption: The query or transmission of the final diagnostic result is performed via separate interfaces.
rationale: EthIf_RunCableDiagnostic merely accepts the diagnostic trigger asynchronously and, according to the specification, has no result parameters.
